description.en: Returns the code of the game's language, used to build file names: "en" (default), "fr", "de", "it" or "es".

The language code.
null if the script system is not ready.

local lang = CMND_GET_LANGUAGE_CODE();
sBasePath = "data/chr/motion/waza/" + sSkillName + "/" + sSkillName + "_";
